title: Fees and grants
description: How much is the tuition fee for the Master in Digital Fashion Communication? Discover it now and check if you are eligible for a scholarship.

blocks.html:
Tuition fees

For students enrolling from the 2027/28 academic year onwards, a semester fee of CHF 5,000 will apply to Bachelor (undergraduate) and Master (graduate) programmes at Università della Svizzera italiana (USI).

The semester fee is reduced to CHF 2,000 in the following cases:

  • students of Swiss nationality;
  • students of foreign nationality who are legally resident in Switzerland or the Principality of Liechtenstein at the time of obtaining their secondary school diploma or other qualification granting access to university studies;
  • students of foreign nationality admitted on the basis of their “dossier” who are legally resident in Switzerland at the time the admission decision is issued;
  • students who acquire Swiss nationality during their period of enrolment, starting from the semester following the acquisition of Swiss nationality;
  • students in the asylum sector who hold a permit issued by the competent Swiss authorities;
  • students holding Swiss or European Union citizenship who are resident in Campione d’Italia.

Students enrolled at USI before the 2027/28 academic year in a Bachelor's or Master's programme will retain the semester fee in effect at the time of their initial enrolment until they complete their current Bachelor's or Master’s degree course.

Students enrolled at USI before the 2027/28 academic year who continue their studies in a Master programme following completion of a Bachelor programme at USI, or who decide to transfer from the Bachelor or Master programme in which they are enrolled to another programme offered by USI, will be subject to the new fee regime from the 2027/28 academic year onwards.

For all students, the fee must be paid at the beginning of each semester, within the deadline indicated on the invoice. Payment of the fee is a necessary condition for obtaining or renewing enrolment.

Additionally, the students will need to contribute to the ANNUAL French academic taxes, which should be paid directly to Paris 1 Panthéon Sorbonne:
Annual National university registration fee in France (NURF) of about 250 € and Contribution de vie étudiante et de campus (CVEC) fee of about 100 €.

USI’s tuition fees are payable at the beginning of each semester.
Paris 1 Panthéon Sorbonne’s tuition fees are payable at the beginning of each academic year.

Grants

Students who have been admitted to the Master in Digital Fashion Communication are eligible to apply for a scholarship from Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne.
